# Advanced Notifier

![Advanced Notifier function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/notifier/advanced.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Wait variants with a reception cursor per notifier object and generation. History tracks encountered sources, not a queue of previous messages.

**Advanced Notifier**

Variantes d’attente avec un repère de réception par objet notificateur et génération. History suit les sources rencontrées, pas une file des anciens messages.

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Wait on Notification with Notifier History](wait_history.md) | Wait with an independent emission cursor for each notifier object and generation encountered by this node instance. A/B/A preserves both cursors. History tracks sources, not all past messages; overwritten values cannot be recovered. The other single-wait ports and timeout/error rules are unchanged. |
| [Wait on Notification from Multiple with Notifier History](wait_multiple_history.md) | Multiple wait with one cursor per object and generation, independent of array indices. Reordering or adding sources does not reset existing cursors. Finishes on any eligible source and returns matching filtered arrays. History does not archive overwritten notifications. Array-valued results use the explicit FROG v1 notification wrapper. |
